from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,csv,io
base='8c94b274ebd6ad91223cdb6df085ca0597c107c9'
for p in ['docs/vision/requirements.csv','docs/vision/original_action_items.md','docs/vision/Development_Blueprint_2026-10-05.md','docs/vision/dependencies.json','docs/vision/source_register.json','docs/vision/rules_certification_template.csv','docs/vision/decision_register.csv','VALIDATION_RESULTS.json','SHA256SUMS.txt']:
 assert Path(p).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+p]),p+' changed unexpectedly'
for p in ['docs/vision/initial_backlog.csv','docs/vision/additional_scope.csv']:
 old=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+p]).decode())))
 new=list(csv.reader(Path(p).open()))
 assert new[:len(old)]==old and len(new)==len(old)+2,p+' prior rows changed'
values=[]
for line in Path('.env.local').read_text().splitlines():
 if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
  key,val=line.split('=',1)
  if any(k in key.upper() for k in ['SECRET','PASSWORD','TOKEN','KEY']):
   val=val.strip().strip(chr(34)).strip(chr(39))
   if val:values.append(val.encode())
assert values,'No known secret values available for scan'
state=json.loads(Path('docs/current-state.json').read_text())
paths=set(state['files'])
paths.update(str(p) for parent in ['docs/changes','docs/validation/logs','docs/validation/runs','docs/validation/archive'] for p in Path(parent).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
paths.update(['CHANGELOG.md','docs/current-state.json'])
hits=[p for p in sorted(paths) if Path(p).is_file() and any(v in Path(p).read_bytes() for v in values)]
assert not hits,'Secret values found in owned artifacts: '+', '.join(hits)
assert Path('.env.local').stat().st_mode & 0o777 ==0o600
r=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check']);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run(['git','check-ignore','--quiet','.env.local']);assert r.returncode==0
print('PASS original scope/register/archive preservation, owner-only ignored private file, whitespace and known-secret scan across '+str(len(paths))+' owned artifacts')
